body:
This report isn't as much to state my experiences with meth, but my experiences with drugs in general. It all started out with alcohol, which turned into pot, which turned into mushrooms, which turned into hard drugs. I am 15 years old and I have done mass amounts of pot, tripped many times on mushrooms, smoked meth, snorted coke, and snorted special K. All of these things have contributed to a sort of depression that I live with everyday. Fucked up thoughts always seem to enter my head about what lifes all about, why we're here, and where I'm going. Before I dabbled into drugs I was a straight A student, clean and sober.
Now, not even a year later, my marks are shitty, my mind is fucked up, I'm broke as hell, and dealing drugs has dug me a bigger hole then I'm already in. A few months ago when I was discovering cocaine and meth, quitting drugs never even crossed my mind - the excitement of trying something new was too much to give up. Now, all I think about is how to quit. I want to quit but I'm constantly around people who do these drugs that I end up doing them as well. All I can say from this is that I'm 15 years old, and my lifes moving in the wrong direction. I just hope I can turn it around before I go too far.
